info.title: SimpleLinuxUpdater Personal API
info.description: Cookie-free business API. Required scope is intersected with the current enabled account role on every request. Credential issuance, sessions, MFA, account changes, backup/restore and metrics-token administration are cookie-only. /metrics uses the separate Metrics Access Credential, never this API bearer. JSON command bodies default to 1048576 bytes (1 MiB), including chunked requests, and must contain exactly one JSON document. Unknown fields remain compatible unless a route explicitly defines a closed schema. Empty bodies remain accepted by commands that support them. Authentication is limited to 8192 bytes, onboarding to 131072 bytes, and post-check profile configuration to 262144 bytes; inventory imports retain their specialized limits. Oversize requests return 413 with a JSON error before mutation.

post.description: Requires audit:read. POST keeps filters out of download links. JSON v1 retains public values; UTF-8 CSV v1 uses CRLF and prefixes spreadsheet-dangerous cells with an apostrophe. Both include a final manifest with canonical filters, exact count, stable order and actual exported timestamp interval (empty strings when empty). Preparation streams to a private temporary file: at most 10000 events, 32 MiB and 15 seconds. Exceeding a bound returns an explicit error before download. Transfer has a separate 30 second deadline, fixed safe filename, Content-Length and Cache-Control: no-store. Client cancellation closes cursors, transactions and the temporary file. No offset pagination; concurrent events do not alter the read snapshot.

personalBearer.description: Create a named expiring personal token through the reauthenticated Account page. Secret is displayed once.

deferral_revision.description: Exact upgrade_plan.package_deferrals.revision from discovery; required for plans with a deferral snapshot.

logs.description: Empty unless effective scopes include logs:read.

BusinessObject.description: Domain response with the stable route-specific fields described in the operator/API guide.

confirm.description: Explicit confirmation is required before a controlled reboot or APT repair is admitted.

scan_id.description: Durable identity of this admitted scan; use this exact identity for cancellation.

job_id.description: Job State Transition identity, equal to scan_id. Job/log endpoints retain logs:read.

VulnerabilityScanProgress.description: Sanitary observed facts shared by direct observation and dashboard/SSE. No raw logs, percentages or ETA. Each first phase and every verification, persistence or enrichment boundary publishes immediately; ordinary repeated counters are bounded to one publication per second.

checkpoint.description: Validated accepted partial boundary; LastAttempt remains running until its owner terminalizes.

VulnerabilityObservation.description: Durable finding ledger and latest accepted scan. Complete stable evidence may resolve its own package even when other packages remain unknown. Whole stable inventory is required to prove removal. Cancelled/interrupted/unavailable scans, package updates alone and legacy counters without proofs cannot close findings. Last complete package proofs survive later unknown scans and supersede older approval observations.

VulnerabilityAssessment.description: Distribution triage scoped to exact ecosystem/source/version, independently of CVSS and candidate availability. Missing legacy data is unknown. Applicability source_match does not prove runtime exploitability; vendor status unimportant is qualified separately, not a package fix. Ubuntu OSV currently cannot distinguish tracker triage statuses; remains unknown.

VulnerabilityFinding.description: Durable package/CVE occurrence. Distribution assessment, severity evidence, candidate disposition and resolution are independent. Existing fields remain available. Component/runtime reclassification never resolves an occurrence or alters its source/vendor assessment.

resolved_occurrences.description: Complete count of currently resolved package/CVE occurrences; occurrences reopened by newer approval evidence are excluded.

resolved_findings.description: At most 50 most recent currently resolved occurrences. The complete count is resolved_occurrences; full durable history remains in the Server vulnerability observation.

kernel_coverage.description: Component context only. evaluated does not imply all kernel vulnerabilities assessed or any exposure confirmed.

not_scanned.description: Includes Docker images, application dependencies and third-party repositories; scope installed_packages means host OS packages only. Missing optional component counts mean zero; missing legacy runtime context means unknown.

active_kernel_occurrences.description: Package/CVE occurrences by component/observed execution, independent of source/vendor distinct-CVE counts. Headers are also execution-unknown; these groups are not disjoint.

inactive_kernel_occurrences.description: Package/CVE occurrences by component/observed execution, independent of source/vendor distinct-CVE counts. Headers are also execution-unknown; these groups are not disjoint.

external_kernel_occurrences.description: Package/CVE occurrences by component/observed execution, independent of source/vendor distinct-CVE counts. Headers are also execution-unknown; these groups are not disjoint.

header_occurrences.description: Package/CVE occurrences by component/observed execution, independent of source/vendor distinct-CVE counts. Headers are also execution-unknown; these groups are not disjoint.

runtime_unknown_occurrences.description: Package/CVE occurrences by component/observed execution, independent of source/vendor distinct-CVE counts. Headers are also execution-unknown; these groups are not disjoint.

VulnerabilityQualificationCounts.description: Dashboard risk.vulnerability: reported_cves counts distinct active IDs; occurrences counts package/ID pairs. Each ID belongs to one category with precedence current vendor-confirmed > needs-review > vendor-qualified > withdrawn across its packages. Only current package observations and current assessments may confirm vendor source matches. Stale/legacy evidence needs review. Counts never assert runtime exploitability. Active occurrences are separated into current and not-reverified evidence; resolved_findings retains closure proof/history and is excluded from active CVE counts. Enrichment failures are independent of package coverage. Runtime component counters and kernel_coverage are separate; confirmed_cves continues to count vendor-confirmed source matches, never confirmed running-kernel vulnerabilities.

VulnerabilityPackageProof.description: Complete paginated source assessment for an exact binary/source identity, bound to an admitted Server and scan. Stable means identity was verified at both inventory boundaries; this does not prove runtime reachability. Legacy absence cannot resolve findings.

VulnerabilityInventoryProof.description: Complete stable whole-inventory proof; package absence can demonstrate removal independently of CVE coverage of remaining packages.

VulnerabilityInventoryAbsenceProof.description: Per-package absence established by a complete stable inventory. Retained to suppress approval snapshots older than that absence after a later unknown reinstall. A base-name cutoff covers qualified aliases only when no architecture of that package was present; an explicit-architecture cutoff does not cover unqualified or foreign-architecture selectors. This is not an evaluation of the current installed version and cannot close new findings.

VulnerabilityResolution.description: Evidence-backed closure of a package/CVE occurrence. Version change does not assert runtime mitigation; no_longer_reported does not invent a vendor fix or withdrawal.

VulnerabilityPackage.description: Inventoried package with independent assessment state and optional complete evidence.

VulnerabilityRuntimeApplicability.description: Observed binary component context, independently of vendor source triage, CVSS, candidate disposition and resolution. No observation proves reachability or exploitability. Legacy missing fields are unknown. runtime_view is the projection after freshness checks; runtime retains the original observation.

VulnerabilityRuntimeContext.description: Fresh bounded unprivileged Host Maintenance Session evidence: uname, systemd virtualization/container detection and exact dpkg image ownership plus installed image/source identities. Ten-second context deadline with transport drain; max 256 images and 128 KiB parsed output. Missing, denied, oversized and malformed probes are unknown. No hypervisor access or privilege escalation.

DashboardVulnerabilityFinding.description: runtime_view uses newer accepted scan or approval host context for retained findings and demotes stale/future/missing or unverified image identities to unknown execution/ownership. runtime retains original evidence. Other distribution/severity/evidence fields remain compatible.

VulnerabilityScanMetrics.description: Observed counters and elapsed milliseconds only; persistence_ms measures checkpoint persistence. Zero metrics may be omitted.

VulnerabilityEnrichment.description: Bounded synchronous optional detail enrichment; completeness is independent from package evaluation. Cached observations retain their original time.
